detection.note: Full stone line + letter detect via inference/stone_ocr.py (MusnadStoneOCR).

notes: Full stone inscription OCR: MusnadStoneOCR (NOT MusnadOCR).
Writes full-image overlay.png with boxes, names, and confidence (save_overlay=True).
Single-glyph stone classify: MusnadPredictor with compare_preprocess=True.
Stone binary preprocess avoids solidifying zig-zag letters (SHIN/MEM/TAW).
Do not force SHIN->MEM overrides; trust CNN when confident.
